heading.en: The best bundle you can afford

hook.en: Your wishes are the indifference map; your wallet is the budget line. Put them on the same graph and the best choice appears.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಸೆಗಳು ತಟಸ್ಥ ನಕ್ಷೆ; ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೇಬು ಆಯವ್ಯಯ ರೇಖೆ. ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟರೆ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: State the condition for consumer's equilibrium (MRS = p₁/p₂)
Explain why points of intersection are not optimal
Apply the equi-marginal rule MUx/Px = MUy/Py

narration.en: Your wishes are the indifference map; your wallet is the budget line. Put them on the same graph and the best choice appears.

body.en: A rational consumer chooses the bundle on the budget line that lies on the highest possible indifference curve. At this optimum the budget line is tangent to an indifference curve, so the slope of the IC equals the slope of the budget line: $MRS = p_1/p_2$. The consumer's own rate of exchange equals the market's rate of exchange.

points.en: Condition 2: MRS diminishes (IC convex) at the optimum
The bundle is on the budget line

narration.en: The optimum is where the budget line just touches the highest indifference curve. There the MRS equals the price ratio.
narration.kn: ಆಯವ್ಯಯ ರೇಖೆ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ತಟಸ್ಥ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯನ್ನು ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಿಸುವ ಬಿಂದುವೇ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆ. ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಬದಲಿಕೆ ದರ ಬೆಲೆ ಅನುಪಾತಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮ.

say.en: Income 40, prices 2 and 4. The budget line runs from 20 units of good 1 to 10 units of good 2.
Three indifference curves. The low one is easy to reach, the high one is out of reach, and one just touches the line.
At E the two slopes are equal: the MRS equals the price ratio, one half.
If MRS is greater than the price ratio, buy more of good 1. If it is smaller, buy more of good 2.

narration.en: Income 40, prices 2 and 4. The budget line runs from 20 units of good 1 to 10 units of good 2.

body.en: If MRS > p₁/p₂, the consumer values good 1 more than the market charges, so buying more of good 1 (and less of good 2) moves him to a higher indifference curve. If MRS < p₁/p₂, he gains by buying more of good 2. Only at tangency can no affordable change raise satisfaction. In utility analysis the same idea appears as the law of equi-marginal utility: $MU_x/P_x = MU_y/P_y$.

points.en: Intersection points: a higher IC is still reachable

narration.en: If the MRS is above the price ratio, buy more of good 1; if below, buy more of good 2. Only at tangency is no improvement possible.
narration.kn: ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಬದಲಿಕೆ ದರ ಬೆಲೆ ಅನುಪಾತಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದ್ದರೆ ಸರಕು 1 ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ; ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಸರಕು 2 ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಸ್ಪರ್ಶ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

caption.en: For utility U = x₁x₂ the optimum is x₁ = M/(2p₁), x₂ = M/(2p₂). Change income and prices: the white curve is the highest IC the budget line touches.

tryThis.en: Lower p₁. How does the optimal good 1 change?
Raise M. Do both goods rise (normal goods)?
Check: at the optimum, MRS = x₂/x₁ equals p₁/p₂.

problem.en: Px = ₹2, Py = ₹3, income = ₹12. MU of X for units 1–5: 20, 16, 12, 8, 4. MU of Y: 24, 18, 12, 6, 3. Find the equilibrium bundle.

steps.en: Equal MU per rupee = 6 at 3 units of X and 2 units of Y.

answer.en: Equilibrium: 3 units of X and 2 units of Y (MUx/Px = MUy/Py = 6).

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Px = ₹2, Py = ₹3, income = ₹12. MU of X for units 1–5: 20, 16, 12, 8, 4. MU of Y: 24, 18, 12, 6, 3. Find the equilibrium bundle.

body.en: MRS is what you are willing to pay in good 2; p₁/p₂ is what the market asks. Buy more of whichever good is cheaper than you value it until they match.

narration.en: Compare the two rates. MRS is what you are willing to pay in good 2; p₁/p₂ is what the market asks. Buy more of whichever good is cheaper than you value it until they match.

homework.en: Draw the consumer's equilibrium diagram and explain what happens at a point where MRS > p₁/p₂.

narration.en: Recap. Optimum: budget line tangent to the highest IC. Condition: MRS = p₁/p₂. If MRS > p₁/p₂ buy more of good 1; if less, buy more of good 2. Utility approach: MUx/Px = MUy/Py.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆ: ಆಯವ್ಯಯ ರೇಖೆ ಅತ್ಯುನ್ನತ ತಟಸ್ಥ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಗೆ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶಕ. ನಿಯಮ: ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಬದಲಿಕೆ ದರ = p₁/p₂. MRS > p₁/p₂ ಆದರೆ ಸರಕು 1 ಹೆಚ್ಚು; ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆದರೆ ಸರಕು 2 ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಉಪಯುಕ್ತತಾ ವಿಧಾನ: MUx/Px = MUy/Py.
